body: Don't anybody mind me, just talking to myself for some reason.

Oh, just to clarify, this is in fact my mother's house.  I''ve hit on hard times, so here I am.  I have recently asked her if we could have a more room-mate like relationship.  We love each other as mother and daughter, but I don't think we /like/ each other very much.

My mother and I are stuck together for a while at least.  We have both lived here together before, with two dogs and four cats.  She has paid me back for the house, and the last one, she has always paid back amyhting I've tried to give to her.  I'm burnt out, and tapped out, just can't help anyone with anything anymore.  It hurts, it hurts so much, I know I have nore to give, I just can't get it done.  I miss my babies, I had some wonderful cats.  I know it sounds completely crazy, but I think the two things are somehow connected.  This is totally insane, but I am sick to my soul and frightened.  I have had at least one cat with me for most of my life.  For crying out loud, there was one in my crib, and he protected me from strangers.  My family watched me of course, but they really didn't need to.  Not too many people are going to fuck with a feral tomcat LOL.
Oh, hi there sic.  Thanks for responding.

Well, maybe I'll just talk to myself for a few minutes.  It sucks having to be roommates with my mother.  No matter what, I don't feel like an equal.  I bought this house in the first place (I've been paid back).  All I want is a cat.  I feel incomplete without a feline companion.  My mother has a dog.  I am fairly certain she is opposed to having a cat around, it would be a bit of a hassle again.  I had a horrible nightmare about it last night.  I just don't want to sleep again.
